reasoning_content: Backup image built. Now generate age key using the image and extract the public key.

action.command: cd /workspace && docker run --rm daz-pilot-backup:latest age-keygen 2>/dev/null > age-identity.txt && cat age-identity.txt && AGE_RECIPIENT=$(grep -o 'age1[a-z0-9]*' age-identity.txt | head -1) && echo "RECIPIENT=$AGE_RECIPIENT" && sed -i "s|^AGE_RECIPIENT=.*|AGE_RECIPIENT=${AGE_RECIPIENT}|" .env && grep -n "^AGE_RECIPIENT=" .env && chmod 600 age-identity.txt && mv age-identity.txt /tmp/age-identity.txt

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && docker run --rm daz-pilot-backup:latest age-keygen 2>/dev/null > age-identity.txt && cat age-identity.txt && AGE_RECIPIENT=$(grep -o 'age1[a-z0-9]*' age-identity.txt | head -1) && echo \"RECIPIENT=$AGE_RECIPIENT\" && sed -i \"s|^AGE_RECIPIENT=.*|AGE_RECIPIENT=${AGE_RECIPIENT}|\" .env && grep -n \"^AGE_RECIPIENT=\" .env && chmod 600 age-identity.txt && mv age-identity.txt /tmp/age-identity.txt", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Generate age keypair and set AGE_RECIPIENT"}
